SAME Greenville Piedmont bungalow lawn and oak, magnolia, crape myrtle, dogwood and pine tree group, same eye-level camera and true scale in all four. TOP LEFT spring: muted fresh green lawn, dogwood flowering, early deciduous leaf-out. TOP RIGHT summer: restrained deep green lawn, full crowns, crape myrtle subdued pink flowers. BOTTOM LEFT autumn: muted olive lawn, variable ochre oak and dogwood reds, evergreen magnolia/pine remain green. BOTTOM RIGHT winter: dormant warm-season grass straw/olive-brown, bare oak/crape/dogwood, evergreen magnolia/pine, NO snow. Lawn type explicitly warm-season reference, no universal rule all turf. Match input image as LOOK ONLY: style-b-calibration-v2 rich real-scale matte surfaces, soft clear neutral afternoon light SAME across seasons, simplified albedo no grass blades/no photographic noise, irregular organic crowns not balls. Plain realistic bungalow, rolling yard. No people, animals, dogs, logos/signage/letters/numbers, public art, UI or watermarks. No mountains.
calibrationEditPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. FIRST image is EDIT TARGET, preserve its triptych/seasonal-panel dimensions, gutters, cameras, regional buildings, roof shapes, lot geometry and tree locations in EVERY PANEL. SECOND image is LOOK ONLY: borrow its simplified matte colour fields, rich structural silhouette, soft coherent neutral lighting and selective detail. DO NOT copy a single building or street from second image. Completely remove photographic microtexture from ALL panels: smooth matte asphalt with no grain, lawns as broad muted albedo patches no blades, roofs smooth dark planes no dense shingles, masonry flat muted fields with selective coarse structural seams not brick noise, foliage irregular softly lobed crowns not dense individual leaves, no dirt. Keep TRUE REAL proportions; not cartoon or miniature. Light matches calibration: clear blue sky, warm-neutral sun, cool-neutral readable shadows, no global yellow wash. Keep time/weather when target is thunderstorm or seasons. Remove ALL people/animals, signs, lettering, logos, vehicle badges; preferably remove any cars. No murals/public art/UI.
seasonalCorrectionPrompt: Remove only central evergreen magnolia flowers in all four seasonal panels; retain lawns, lighting, geometries, spring dogwood and summer crape flowers.
